_evidence: Texture-slot state for the two 4-row copies inside 0x0051cedd (compose AFTER copy_0051cac6, which randomises all 1024 words of 0x9e1b20, and after ent_0051c91d, whose 64-byte +0xc buffers this widens). 0x51ca84: 'mov ebx,0x322; movzx ebx,word [ebx*2+0x9e1b20]' (word 0x9e2164), 0x51ccd6: 'mov ebx,0x334; ...' (word 0x9e2188); 'cmp bx,-1; je' = no texture, otherwise 'add ebx,0x6975ec': the word is the byte offset of a 0x20-byte entry of the texture table (0x51c058 stores edi-0x6975ec in 0x9e1b20[], 0x51bfb6 resets every word to 0xffff), so 0xffff or k*0x20; a random word (copy_0051cac6) points the entry anywhere and faulted at 0x51cab1/0x51cd03. Then 'mov esi,[ebx+0xc]; mov edi,0x968f5c|0x96935c; mov ebp,4; movzx ecx,word [ebx+0x10]; rep movsb; add esi,0x100; add edi,0x100; dec ebp; jne': four rows of +0x10 bytes from +0xc at stride 0x100, i.e. [src, src+0x300+len). Neither word is written by the callees that run before them in 0x51cedd (0x551b3d, 0x51c6c3, 0x51c690, 0x51c770, 0x51c8c0, 0x51c8e9, 0x51c746 only write 0x891030.., 0x95422c, 0x937de8.. and texel bytes; 0x51cac6, which writes words 0x42d..0x43c, runs after both). Entries 0..3 (the offsets drawn here and by ent_0051c91d): +0xc points at a distinct 0x400-byte random buffer and the u16 length +0x10 is 1..256, so the copies stay inside it (0x300+0x100) and inside the 0x400-byte destinations; 0x51c91d reads the same two fields as 4 rows of +0x10 bytes from +0xc ([esi, esi+4*len) <= 0x400) and needs len >= 1 ('loop' would run 2^32 times on 0), so the domain stays valid for it. Values are synthetic.
